Resolves #19882

Both RealWorld apps work again. Their only backend was gone: `api.realworld.io` answers 530, and `conduit.productionready.io` redirects there. Both `API_URL` constants now name the RealWorld project's own hosted, key-free API, `https://api.realworld.show/api`, so the feeds and tags load.

Evidence: L3 (both apps loaded on a local dev server against the live hosted API) → L3 required (AC-2 is a browser read). Residual: none.

`apps/**` gate: the diff is a URL constant in two config modules. I read them against each other and against realworld2's `api/Base.mjs`, which derives every call from that constant. No component, store, provider or model code is touched.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Both `config.mjs` files in this diff name `https://api.realworld.show/api` |
| AC-2 | Outside CI, browser: realworld lists 4 articles (johndoe, janesmith, mikewilson, sarahchen) and 15 tags, console clean. realworld2 fills its feed and tag panel. The dead-host CORS redirect and both `reading 'json'` TypeErrors are gone (they reproduce on dev's URLs in the same session) |

## Deltas from ticket
AC-2 narrowed while verifying. Realworld2 renders its home view twice and throws `reading 'subscribe'` on load. Both happen identically on dev's URLs, so they are not backend-related; they are out of scope, noted in the defect-note of 2026-10-20 09:17Z.

## Test Evidence
Local dev server, fresh tab per load. Realworld v1 with this diff: feed + tags, no console errors. Realworld2 on dev's URLs: CORS block on the redirect to `api.realworld.io`, two `reading 'json'` TypeErrors, empty feed. Realworld2 with this diff: feed + tags render, only the pre-existing `subscribe` error and double render remain.
